The whole book is the manual, and everyone needs special education. This is the product that delivers it.

## What it is

Free, forever. Special Education teaches you this manual to the level your job as a [Humanity Manager](../appendix/humanity-manager-employment-agreement.qmd) needs. It is called special education because [everyone is retarded](../problem/i-am-retarded.qmd) and everyone needs it: you, me, the people in charge of the nuclear weapons. There is no remedial class, because there is no other kind.

## How it works

You do not read eighty chapters alone. Wishonia teaches you one-on-one: she walks you through the manual, answers your questions, notices what you did not understand, and explains it again a different way. It adapts to you, because special education for eight billion people at every level has to meet each one where they are. The [orientation film](../educational-film.qmd) is the trailer, the manual is the text, Wishonia is the teacher.

## What you learn, and how you pass

The four things the book teaches: why your species misallocates everything, the math showing the fix is the best trade available, the mechanisms that do the fixing, and the thirty seconds of action that start it. Enough to do the job, not a PhD. [The qualifying exam](../appendix/humanity-manager-employment-agreement.qmd) is the comprehension check; pass it and you get your certificate.

## What it costs

You: nothing, ever. The expensive part is the compute to run a patient one-on-one tutor for billions of people, paid for by donations, revenue, or donated compute from the companies that have it. When there is enough, we will pay *you* to take it, because a Manager who understands the plan is worth more than the lesson costs.
